* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Cancel Broken Concentration, The Circle Is Now Complete, or a duel initiated during battle. OR During any draw phase, place a card from hand under your Used Pile to take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). (Immune to Young Fool.) OR During any draw phase, place a card from hand under your Used Pile to take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.”<ref name="cl-1220_150-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
